correctness.rationale: A local update exchanges exactly the two incident walls. If the wall transpositions before and after site zero are B and A, then B conjugates ASB to BAS; BA uses every edge of a path once and is a full cycle. Indeed, removing the last edge gives two component cycles by induction, and the last transposition joins them. Composing the full cycle with S splits it at the two walls incident to site zero, which lie in distinct resulting cycles, even when one is a singleton. In coordinates (Bd,x_0), the increment of x_0 is the sum at those two walls. A p^t-fixed wall vector on the cycles of lengths a,b has independent blocks of sizes gcd(a,t) and gcd(b,t); even parity of the full wall and zero net bit increment give exactly the two rows of Q_t on their two parity sums. Both sums are independently attainable before imposing the rows, so no rank is lost in translating from Q_t to the full block space. Each valid wall gives two fixed states. Invertibility gives the primitive census by divisor inversion. The wall action on even vectors is faithful for n>=3 because a permutation fixing every unordered pair fixes each vertex. At L the only possible remaining effect is the common wall-cycle parity multiplied by n/g in the fiber; parity one is realized by a wall in each cycle. This proves minimality and the exact doubling condition. A fresh replay on 1,173 orders, exhaustive through n=6 with samples at n=7,8,9, matched 16,089 fixed-power counts, all map orders and 11,907 primitive-count comparisons.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration tests only the stated exhaustions and samples. It is not an argument for repeated-site, synchronous or heterogeneous schedules.

value.rationale: Every orbit length and its multiplicity can be obtained from two lengths without iterating the 2^n states. The formula also distinguishes sweeps whose lifted order is twice their wall order, explaining an effect that a wall-only calculation would miss. This is an exact phase-space invariant for a standard sequential automaton, beyond an upper bound or finite list of schedules.
residual_risks: The finding does not enumerate schedules by type or extend the census to arbitrary repeated-site update words.
